mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all24 fresh ACES1.05 medium-fi views: noon/late economy/high, silhouette, lantern/landing/base, district/street lantern, street landing and four level transitions. Four explicit authored levels retain the full36m tapered silhouette, cornice/lantern/dome/cage, signed solar bay and attached access route. The far level uses polygonal profile/color bands and four broad cage ribs; coarse levels intentionally omit fine wire/grid/course detail. Near models use the existing shared graphs. The generic reducer could not meet the district ceiling with its isolated surface topology, so coherent authored levels replace all automatic derivatives. Runtime triangles 748 / 3854 / 10906 / 24250;draws 1 / 5 / 7 / 7;initial skyline+district 346456bytes;closeup1699244bytes. Actual caps and separate position streams pass. Error reservations describe authored simplification and are not formal whole-mesh deviation measurements. Physical phone/laptop frame-time measurements remain pending.
